description: Semantic role map for TREC 9-17 Unimproved Property Contract (10 pages, 271 AcroForm widgets). Coordinates extracted directly from the live AcroForm widget rects (pdf-lib getRectangle(), widgets resolved to pages via /P refs), same method as api/_assets/trec-20-19-esign-coords.json. Roles/keys/checkbox-meanings derived from viewing EVERY page of the rendered numbered overlay (.tmp/coord-overlays/unimproved-property-page-*.png) against the printed form text — NOT from the AcroForm field names, which on this form are frequently generic ("undefined_N", "Text3"), recycled from other clauses, or SWAPPED (see notes: party-name blanks 1:1/1:2, title-policy expense boxes 2:3/2:4, and the oak-wilt pair 5:12/5:13, among others). x_pct/y_pct/w_pct/h_pct are top-left-origin PERCENTAGES 0-100 of the 612x792pt page (divide by 100 before feeding DocuSeal areas[], which expects 0-1 fractions). Roles beyond the addenda convention: escrow_agent (page-10 receipt blocks, filled by the title company) and selling_agent (page-9 Selling Associate block). Page 9 is print-only ("Print name(s) only. Do not sign").
initialFooterNote: Printed "Initialed for identification by Buyer ___ and Seller ___" footer appears on pages 1-7 ONLY, each with 4 live widgets (left-to-right buyer1 x~211pt, buyer2 x~253, seller1 x~347, seller2 x~396, y~19-21pt bottom-origin). Pages 8 (signature), 9 (broker info) and 10 (receipts) have NO visible initial line and NO footer widgets — verified by rendering pages 8-10 (only "TREC NO. 9-17" prints at bottom right; pdftotext finds hidden footer words in the content stream on 8-10 but they do not render, confirmed at 200dpi crop). Unlike the 20-19, no synthetic footer rects are needed.
signatureNote: Page 8 signature grid: upper-left buyer1 (Signature11), upper-right seller1 (Signature13), lower-left buyer2 (Signature12), lower-right seller2 (Signature14). Matched to the printed "Buyer"/"Seller" captions below each rule by position. No per-signature date fields; the only date is the EXECUTED (Effective Date) line, which the broker fills.
